PluginData.Author: scotlandsyard
PluginData.Tooltip: Adds up the components, ingots and ore a projection, blueprint or grid takes to build.
PluginData.Description:
Adds up what something takes to build: the components, the ingots the assembler needs for them and the ore the refinery needs for those ingots. It works from a projection, a blueprint in your local F10 library or one of your own grids, and uses the definitions the game has loaded, mods included.
It can count only what is still needed, take off what you carry or what is in the grid's cargo, and write the list to a datapad. It can also queue the components in an assembler or a group of them, showing what it would add first, with an undo, or send the list to a Sacrificial Stockpile Manager crate.
Quick start: 1. Type /tally in chat. 2. Pick a source (Projector, Blueprint (F10) or My grid) to get the components, ingots and ore. 3. Blueprints must be in your Local list. Carry a datapad to use Write datapad.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/tree/main/Projects/Tally Report bugs: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/issues
